comparison_sets.ensemble_comparison: best_single = highest recomputed-SPS non-ensemble, non-baseline leaderboard row (raw or product framework) evaluated on at least as many questions as the ensemble, after per-(model, framework, dataset) dedup; random_baseline = recomputed SPS of the random-baseline run for the same dataset (n in random_baseline_n).
comparison_sets.ensemble_error_correlation: For each dataset's published ensemble: pairwise Pearson r between the constituent runs' committed per-question JSD vectors (each run's error magnitude vs the canonical human distribution), over the ensemble's common question set, read from the exact files named in ensemble_sources. Measures whether constituents err on the same questions. Signed per-option residual correlations need the stripped human_distribution fields (#308) and are carried as the ensemble_signed_error_correlation asserted constant.
comparison_sets.temperature_sweep: OpinionsQA sweep-tagged Althing runs (' t=' provider suffix); mean/std of recomputed SPS across the n_runs replications per (model, temperature) cell.
comparison_sets.conditioning_results: Per-group conditioned SubPOP evaluations (Haiku 4.5, t=0.85); mean p_dist / p_cond across n_replications runs carrying a demographic_breakdown for the group.
comparison_sets.template_comparison: SubPOP persona-template variant runs (Haiku 4.5, t=0.85, 100 questions); mean/std of recomputed SPS across n_runs.
comparison_sets.elicitation_comparison: Matched pairs of deduped runs differing only in elicitation mode: a run whose config carries an explicit elicitation template variant (e.g. tpl=structured, schema-forced capture) vs the natural-elicitation run of the identical configuration (same base provider, dataset, samples_per_question, question_set_hash, temperature, effort, and question count). All scores recomputed from per-question rows; deltas are structured minus natural.
comparison_sets.nonresponse_fidelity: Per deduped non-baseline run whose committed per-question rows still carry human_distribution (full-tier datasets; gated files are stripped per #308): mean |model explicit-nonresponse mass (DK-style option mass + parsed refusal rate) - human's|, plus the five items with the largest model over-selection.

asserted_constants.name: base_entropy_h5
asserted_constants.value: base output entropy (bits, default temperature): GPT-4o-mini 0.22, Claude Haiku 4.5 0.36, Gemini Flash Lite 0.56
asserted_constants.source: Experiment H5 notebook analysis (2026-04-12) of default-temperature model_distribution rows; the notebook output was not committed, so the exact values are asserted.

asserted_constants.name: ensemble_signed_error_correlation
asserted_constants.value: pairwise Pearson r of constituents' per-option signed residuals (model probability − human probability) on the ensemble common question sets: globalopinionqa 0.27–0.44, opinionsqa 0.36–0.38, subpop 0.36–0.42 — all pairs moderately positively correlated
asserted_constants.source: Computed 2026-07-16 from the committed constituents' per-question model_distribution rows plus canonical human-distribution rehydration (synthbench.human_distributions); committed gated artifacts strip human_distribution (#308), so the signed residuals are not derivable from public artifacts alone. The JSD-based correlations in ensemble_error_correlation ARE derivable and are recomputed by the drift guard.

asserted_constants.name: template_refusal_collapse
asserted_constants.value: P_refuse collapses from ~0.80 to 0.40-0.50 on templates with unfilled format-string placeholders
asserted_constants.source: Session-1 template-variant analysis (2026-04-12); per-component P_refuse for the template runs is derivable in principle but the published block only tracks composite SPS for templates.
